display_name: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset HUC-12 Subwatersheds Mississippi
known_limitations: HUC-12 polygons provide watershed/subwatershed screening context and do not establish direct project impacts.
Materialization selects subwatersheds intersecting the project analysis bounds and preserves the selected watershed polygons for context rendering.
Hydrologic context still requires reviewer interpretation and does not replace field or agency review.
notes: Manually downloaded Mississippi HUC-12 shapefile bundle. Raw agency files are preserved under raw/ and remain local/ignored.
